title: It's Over 9000
blurb: Vegeta's scouter gives out, and the English dub hands us a number that was never in the original. The Japanese version says eight thousand; a dub mistranslation created one of the internet's oldest surviving memes. It has been in continuous circulation since the mid-2000s, which in internet years is geological. Use it whenever a figure is absurdly, unreasonably high: power levels, temperatures, energy drink caffeine content, the number of times you have rewatched the same series. A genuine fossil, still fully operational.
origin: Vegeta's iconic power-level line from Dragon Ball Z.
